title: Light Peruvian Kanten Agar Bowl
description: A refreshing and energizing Peruvian dish featuring kanten agar, pickle, and peppery flavors, served in a terracotta dish. This nut-free friendly bowl is perfect for a healthy snack.
instructions: Combine kanten agar powder and water in a saucepan and whisk until the powder is dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chopped aji amarillo pepper and salt.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until set.
Once set, cut the kanten agar into small cubes and place them in a terracotta dish.
Top the kanten agar cubes with pickle slices, lime juice, and chopped cilantro leaves.
Serve the Light Peruvian Kanten Agar Bowl chilled, garnished with additional cilantro leaves if desired.
